name: Kevin Probst
headline:
Co-Founder GROWn Ups | GTM Startup Mentor  | Yoga Teacher 
Building Europe’s #1 company for Men’s Holistic Growth & Wellbeing
summary:
I’m Kevin and I’m building GROWn Ups – a men’s mental fitness and holistic health community.

We create spaces where men can be real with each other, try out science-backed tools, and build habits that actually stick. From breathwork, strength training and sleep to emotional hygiene, relationships and purpose.

GROWn Ups combines:

- Cohort-based journeys (like our Founders Cohort)

- In-person events & circles

- Expert-led modules on mental wellbeing, performance and health

The goal: help growth-minded men feel better, think clearer, and show up more grounded - at work, at home, in their relationships and with themselves.

If you’re curious about joining a cohort, bringing this into your company, or collaborating as an expert – I’m always happy to connect.

GROWn Ups is a men’s mental fitness and growth community - built to help men feel better, think clearer, and show up more grounded in work and life.

We create guided group journeys and local cohorts where men can be real with each other, try out simple, science-backed tools, and turn good intentions into habits – from strength training, sleep and breathwork to emotions, relationships and purpose.

Together with experts in movement, therapy, coaching and neuroscience, we make personal growth practical, approachable and something you actually look forward to.

Because when men grow, everyone wins.

Your Growth. Your Game. Level Up for Real.

company.name: GROWn Ups
company.description:
At GROWn Ups our goal is clear: To build the #1 company for men’s holistic health and growth in Europe.

We believe that true strength comes from self-awareness, authenticity, and connection — and that lasting impact on how we live, relate, and lead on this earth together starts right here.

We want men to take real ownership of their health and happiness and to reconnect with themselves and others. Because when men show up healthier, more grounded, and connected, the ripple effect creates a better world for everyone.

How do we bring this to life?

By creating deeply relatable content, hosting transformative experiences, and launching digital tools and physical spaces that embody our values. We empower growth-minded men through content, experiences, and community, offering insights, inspiration, and real-life tools for holistic growth.

→ Join us on this journey. Let’s grow — for ourselves, and for each other.
